definitions.explanation: Describes doing or saying something without showing emotion, in a detached or composed manner.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{淡々|たんたん}と{事実|じじつ}を{述|の}べた。
{淡々|たんたん}と{仕事|しごと}をこなす。
examples.english: To handle work calmly and steadily.

examples.japanese: {淡々|たんたん}とした{口調|くちょう}で{話|はな}した。
examples.english: She spoke in a dispassionate tone.

notes:
{淡々|たんたん} conveys emotional detachment and composure. Can be positive (professional calm), neutral, or slightly cold depending on context.

GRAMMAR:
- Adverb: {淡々|たんたん}と + verb
- Na-adjective: {淡々|たんたん}とした + noun
- Taru-adjective: {淡々|たんたん}たる + noun (formal/literary)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {淡々|たんたん}と{話|はな}す: to speak dispassionately
- {淡々|たんたん}とした{態度|たいど}: matter-of-fact attitude
- {淡々|たんたん}と{仕事|しごと}をする: to work steadily without fuss
- {淡々|たんたん}と{日々|ひび}を{過|す}ごす: to live each day calmly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冷静|れいせい}: calm, composed (more about rational thinking)
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}いた: calm, settled (warmer tone)
- {無表情|むひょうじょう}: expressionless (more negative)
